headline: Cedarville lose at home twice in five days
dek: Cedarville finished top of the table unbeaten in fourteen matches, then lost on their own ground to Ashland and to Findlay in turn. All six goals they have conceded in twenty-one matches came in their three defeats; in the other eighteen they kept a clean sheet.
displaced_by: Findlay won at Cedarville on Nov 12, so the standing dek's 'four goals conceded in twenty matches' is no longer true (now six in twenty-one).

pattern.text: Scoring and standing run together: the five programmes with 30 goals or more are the five at the top of the table.
